resources.string: "Complete the steps below to get started."

"Most devices need locationjoystick set as the mock location app for spoofing to work. Skip only if you've confirmed mock location works another way — for example, a modified setup Android doesn't detect."
"Required to read your real position for map centering and route recording."
"Required for the floating joystick and quick-access widget while other apps are open."

"In Developer Options, find 'Select mock location app' and choose locationjoystick. If you installed the app in a work profile (e.g. via Shelter), open Developer Options in that same profile — Android won't let a different profile select it."

"Skip this step if you don’t want to use Tap to Walk. Tap to Walk uses Android’s Accessibility permission to take screenshots of your game: a few hundred during a one-time 10 minute calibration walk you start yourself, so your taps land where you tapped."
